title: Loss of the vehicle link is detected, reported and recorded
purpose: The operator must be told within seconds when vehicle data stops arriving, and the surrounding record must be preserved for investigation. Requirement R-LINK-1.
expected_behaviour: A critical link.lost alert appears within 3 s and clears within 5 s of the link returning. An incident package is produced and verifies. The vehicle is not commanded by the monitors and continues its mission.

criteria.description: No link or anomaly alert before the fault
criteria.expected: no alert starting with ['nav.', 'telemetry.', 'battery.implausible', 'control.', 'security.', 'link.'] before the fault
alert link.lost within 3 s of the fault

criteria.description: The alert clears when the link returns
criteria.expected: alert link.lost clears within 5 s of the fault ending
criteria.observed: cleared 0.26 s after the fault ended

criteria.description: The mission is not interrupted by the monitors

criteria.expected: the incident package verifies against its manifest

criteria.description: The record of what AEGIS saw during the event is complete
criteria.observed: 100% of the expected state records; 0 s with none

incident_completeness.note: A record without a link holds the last values AEGIS had, marked connected=false; it is not a measurement of the vehicle.

limitations: The link is reported as down inside AEGIS; MAVLink between PX4 and AEGIS is not actually interrupted.
Built-in PX4 simulator only; no network between the vehicle and the backend.
The fault is injected into AEGIS's copy of the telemetry; the vehicle itself keeps receiving correct data.
One run under one set of conditions. It does not show behaviour under other conditions, and it is not a safety certification.
